en: Guess we can't go this way.{PAGE}Man... There's drawings all over the{SAUT}walls. What's that called again?
I believe the word you're looking for is{SAUT}"graffiti." It's often been labeled an{SAUT}indicator for the decline of public safety.

However, lately, some have recognized{SAUT}it as an art. I've heard there's even{SAUT}been exhibitions held for it.{PAGE}Supposedly, when an artist finds{SAUT}artwork they consider worse than their{SAUT}own, they'll paint over it.
So, this is art too? I don't really get it...

Regardless of what one's art looks like,{SAUT}painting over another's piece without{SAUT}their permission seems disrespectful...{PAGE}But perhaps that's how they pit their{SAUT}skills against one another...
Ah, yes, I suppose that's one way to look{SAUT}at it. I'd imagine it's somewhat of an{SAUT}unspoken rule among such artists.
That would certainly make others eager{SAUT}to demonstrate their skills. Well then,{SAUT}maybe I, too, should―
He's right, Inari. We don't have time,{SAUT}so rein it in.
Very well, then... I suppose I'll have to{SAUT}save it for another time.
